meaning: A soft dependency is one where the consumer keeps working (possibly degraded) when the provider is down. Only edges verified in source code or in a specification are listed. Every other edge is treated as hard.

groups.reason: Feature-flag reads use OpenFeature SDKs. OpenFeature spec requirement 1.4.10: flag evaluation must return the default value on abnormal execution and must not throw. Checkout also only logs flagd provider errors (src/checkout/main.go lines 199-207).
groups.source: https://openfeature.dev/specification/sections/flag-evaluation ; OpenFeature imports found in each service's source

groups.reason: A failed order-confirmation email is logged as a warning and the order still returns (src/checkout/main.go lines 411-415).

Checkout publishes each order to Kafka after the order is built and waits for an answer (src/checkout/main.go lines 417-424 and 664-713, not in a goroutine). A failure or timeout is only logged and the order is still returned, though it can be delayed until the request deadline.

not_checked: frontend-proxy routes (to frontend, flagd, flagd-ui, image-provider, load-generator) and the frontend's calls to backend services are still treated as hard.
